# JoyUI

> React + Tailwind CSS v4 design system for dashboards and agentic UIs.
> npm: @joyui/react · CLI/MCP: joyui · Registry: @joyui

## Install

- npm: `pnpm add @joyui/react`
- Registry: `npx shadcn@latest registry add @joyui=https://joyui.dev/r/{name}.json`
- CLI: `npx joyui@latest init --yes` then `npx joyui@latest add button data-table --yes`
- MCP: `npx -y joyui@latest mcp`
- Skill: `npx joyui@latest skill`

- [Quick start](https://joyui.dev/docs): Overview and install paths

## Registry

- Catalog: https://joyui.dev/r/registry.json
- Item: https://joyui.dev/r/{name}.json

## Agent preference order

1. JoyUI MCP stdio — `npx -y joyui@latest mcp`
2. shadcn MCP with `@joyui` registry configured
3. Plain HTTP registry JSON + `joyui add` / `shadcn add`
